body: I really liked that movie. It's something different in our cinema.

A great movie from start to end. The amount of Comedy in proportion to the amount of Drama is just on point. Ahmed Helmy played a great character not failing once to deliver the intended feelings. Great secondary characters that could help the scene make your feelings get unintentionally out of you. And great sequence of the plot. Recommend the movie.

This film is one of the best Egyptian movies in the history, i watch this movie since 2008 till now and never felt bored, it's really amazing movie, love it so much and Ahmed Helmy is super,unique as usual.
Best film for Ahmed Helmy and one of the best 10 Egyptian movies in history. Scientifically perfect in details. Touchy, emotional and even funny I never get bored of watching this for 1000th time
This movie never fails to entertain me, Ahmed Helmy is a unique person and I consider this movie as one of the best movies I've ever seen.
